about: Nelson is a city in the West Kootenay region of British Columbia, on the West Arm of Kootenay Lake. A preserved heritage downtown, arts culture, and mountain-lake recreation define this classic interior mountain town. About 11,000 people live in Nelson.
seoSummary: West Kootenay city on Kootenay Lake’s West Arm—heritage downtown, arts culture, and mountain-lake recreation.
